source.citation: Lee J, Zhang H, Arens E. Typical Clothing Ensemble Insulation Levels for Sixteen Body Parts. Proceedings of CLIMA 2013. Center for the Built Environment, UC Berkeley.
source.method: Whole-body intrinsic insulation (clo) measured on a 16-segment female thermal manikin seated on a mesh arm chair, 20 °C, 50 % RH, 0.1 m/s. Every ensemble includes bra and panty. Numbers transcribed from Table 3; descriptions kept as printed.
source.note: Only measured numbers are used, with attribution. Garment types are Weathrobe's mapping, not the authors'.
